evidence.snippet: const cleanHtml = DOMPurify.sanitize(rawHtml, { ALLOWED_TAGS: [...], ALLOWED_ATTR: [...], ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP: ... })
evidence.why: Real sanitiser (DOMPurify) with explicit tag/attr allowlist and URI scheme restriction is applied to markdown-rendered HTML before it is returned to the client.
dangerouslySetInnerHTML is used, but the html value it receives was already sanitised server-side with DOMPurify, satisfying the not-vulnerable condition.
